title: 1981-04-16_Pat_62.txt
concise_summary: PKD argues that his 2-3-74 experience involved the alchemical union of two human psyches (himself and a mysterious 'Thomas') to create Christ (Ditheon), which he documents as a coherent philosophical progression across the VALIS trilogy. He develops a metaphysical framework distinguishing three evolutionary orders—android (machine/programmed), human (ensouled), and Ditheon (divine/future)—keyed to Joachim of Fiore's three ages and Dante's Commedia, grounded in three forms of causation (cyclic, linear, and acausal/synchronous time). This transforms his theology from mystical experience into a systematic ontology bridging alchemy, Gnosticism, and information theory.
key_claims: Christ (Ditheon) was created through an alchemical conjunction of two human psyches in the 2-3-74 experience; I was one half, neither myself nor an invader becoming Christ, but both parts transmuted into Christ

The fundamental ontological distinction between android (programmed, soulless) and authentic human (ensouled, autonomous) lies in the birth of the soul through love (agapé) and empathy, not mere rationality

The VALIS trilogy forms a unified theological argument: Valis explores Ditheon hesitantly, Divine Invasion mediates the transformation from 'saw Christ' to 'is Christ', and BTA completes the alchemical metamorphosis through the Bodhisattva

Evolution now runs backward from the end of creation (Joachim's third age) via acausal/synchronous time, where future impinges retroactively on past; biological organization transforms into pure information generation and recombination

The authentic self emerges not through Stoic cessation of passion but through triumph over Schopenhauer's impersonal will via consciousness, empathy, and agapé—distinguishing it from both Buddhist renunciation and mere ego
Prior to 2-3-74 I was a Karmic machine (android/programmed); the transformation's suddenness and my newfound freedom (Angel Archer) signal genuine ensouling—a 'birth from above' in Christian terms
recurring_concepts: Alchemical transformation / chemical wedding / mysterium coniunctionis
Three evolutionary orders / levels of ontological organization

Backward-flowing evolution (reversal of entropy, information self-generating)
The three persons of the Trinity keyed to power, wisdom, and love
tensions: How can two human psyches combine to form Christ if Christ is divine? Are both parties truly human, or is one already semi-divine?
If I was a programmed android pre-2-3-74, in what sense am I the same being post-2-3-74? Does authentic selfhood entail a break with personal continuity?
Can acausal/synchronous time (future determining past) be reconciled with linear causality and the Trinity's historical descent?
Is the Bodhisattva path (empathic renunciation) compatible with Schopenhauer's denial of the will? Does Buddhist renunciation differ from Christian agapé only nominally?
The text is truncated mid-sentence; PKD appears to be comparing recombinant information of the third age to fixed Torah law and spirit of law—the logical conclusion is unclear
Is the 'true self' that triumphs over the will identical with or distinct from the empirical ego? PKD asserts their distinction but the metaphysical basis is ambiguous
evidence_quotes: "Christ did not enter me + I did not become Christ; both parts were human + yet Christ resulted: this is why we speak of an alchemical transformation, the chemical wedding, mysterium conunctionis."
"I was not Christ; Thomas (whoever he was + wherever he came from) was not Christ but we together were transformed into Christ in the 'chemical wedding' of the Hermetic alchemists."
"one does not see Christ, one is transmuted into Christ (but one is only one part of the compound; this must absolutely be understood!)"

"The ensouled individual - the true human - has somehow triumphed over the will... + for it. Not all this points as much to Buddhist renounceation (Sp) as it does to Xtianity, but it indicates a covert goal + purpose concealed within Xtian ethics."
"[The VALIS trilogy] deals specifically + with this bringing together of mundane ('Base') elements so they combine to form Gold ('divine' or 'noble')."
uncertainty_flags: Identity of 'Thomas' is never clarified—could be a historical, fictional, or mystical entity
Reference to 'Russ' and the letter at the opening is fragmented; context is missing
'BTA' likely refers to the third VALIS novel, but the acronym is not spelled out
The 'Ditheon dream' is referenced but not fully narrated; its specific content is implied rather than stated
'Ditheon' etymology and historical precedent unclear; may be PKD's neologism or an obscure theological term
Reference to 'Laura' in the letter context is vague; her relationship to the android/human distinction is gestured but not elaborated
The claim about 'Christ being present in the 2-3-74 experience' is asserted but the epistemological grounds (how he knows this) are not explained
The truncated ending prevents full assessment of PKD's argument about recombinant information vs. Torah and spirit of law
It is unclear whether 'Karmic machine' refers to Eastern (Hindu/Buddhist) karma doctrine or a general mechanistic fatalism
